raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This is a horizontal bar chart showing the percentage of people who consider certain measures to be important for limiting the "hidden economy" in the country. The chart has 12 categories on the vertical axis, each representing a different measure. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of people who support each measure, ranging from 0% to over 13%. The categories are listed in a vertical order, and the percentages are displayed as horizontal bars, with blue bars indicating lower percentages and red bars indicating higher percentages. The measures listed include increasing border control, limiting mafia activity, easing credit conditions, reducing corruption, improving administrative quality, increasing judicial efficiency, strengthening tax control, introducing effective business incentives, adopting stricter laws, reducing excise duties, reducing VAT, reducing profit tax, and reducing personal income tax. The corresponding percentages are 2%, 10%, 3%, 13%, 9%, 5%, 2%, 5%, 3%, and 3%, respectively.
